sampling.order: rotate A0/A1/B by round and case; all warm jobs, then all cold jobs, then serial memory/baseline jobs
sampling.controls: A0/A1/B are the exact same admitted artifact, not three tool versions
sampling.warmScope: Per-call means from batches bounded by minSampleMs or256calls; every distinct immutable SVG is checked outside clocks, byte-identical admitted returns reuse qualification; individual first-use samples are fresh processes
sampling.commentVariantScope: Trailing comment changes only source bytes, never semantic graph; this is a cache-key diagnostic
sampling.coldScope: Concurrent import preparation behind an idle barrier; one measured API call at a time and complete child exit before the next
sampling.memoryScope: Separate serial fresh processes; API snapshots precede qualification, GNU time describes the whole worker
sampling.backendScope: Agentic graph families only, identical authored source per engine, fallback:none; public SVG-with-receipt API and complete enumerable sidecars consumed inside timing; every emitted decision checked outside timing. Missing decisions/ignored options do not earn backend-specific timing credit.
